# CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH accepts views as the input to element tables, with explicit keys.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-schema-statements.md
CREATE FUNCTION scalar_graph.view_graph_display(s STRING) AS (UPPER(s));
CREATE VIEW scalar_graph.ViewPeople AS
  SELECT id, scalar_graph.view_graph_display(name) AS display FROM scalar_graph.Person;
CREATE VIEW scalar_graph.ViewKnows AS
  SELECT id, src, dst FROM scalar_graph.Knows WHERE id IN (10, 11);
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH scalar_graph.ViewGraph
  NODE TABLES (scalar_graph.ViewPeople KEY (id))
  EDGE TABLES (scalar_graph.ViewKnows KEY (id)
    SOURCE KEY (src) REFERENCES ViewPeople (id)
    DESTINATION KEY (dst) REFERENCES ViewPeople (id));
SELECT STRING_AGG(CONCAT(src, '>', dst), ',' ORDER BY src, dst)
FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.ViewGraph
  MATCH (a:ViewPeople)-[:ViewKnows]->(b:ViewPeople)
  RETURN a.display AS src, b.display AS dst)
=> "ALEX>DANA,DANA>ALEX"
